title: Darin Glass on 'financial gravity': 'The leaders who resist it aren't choosing between mission and growth. They're holding both.'
summary: Strategy and operations leader Darin Glass uses Incorruptible's 'financial gravity' framing to describe the leaders who resist mission drift while still growing.
blockquote: Eric Ries has been talking about this ahead of his new book Incorruptible. He calls it "financial gravity," the structural pull that drags companies away from their original purpose. The leaders who resist it aren't choosing between mission and growth. They're holding both.
